IV. 1. 139</ls>] Belonging to a noble family. .{@-नः@} .²1 The son of a female beggar. .²2 A follower of the left hand Śākta ritual. .{@-नम्@} .²1 An evil report, a scandal; मालविकागतं किमपि कौलीनं श्रूयते <ls>M. 3</ls>; तदेव कौलीनमिव प्रतिभाति <ls>V. 2</ls>; <ls>Me. 114</ls>; कौलीनमात्माश्रयमाचचक्षे <ls>R. 14. 36</ls>, <ls n="R. 14.">84</ls>. .²2 An improper act, bad or scandalous conduct; ख्याते तस्मिन् वितमसि कुले जन्म कौलीनमेतत् <ls>Ve. 2. 10</ls>. .²3 A combat of animals. .²4 Cock-fighting. .²5 War, battle (in general). .²6 High birth. .²7 A privity, the pudenda.
